verified_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance showing net sales decreased to SEK 295M (from SEK 352M in 2024) with EBITDA of SEK 17M (third consecutive positive year but down from SEK 47M), EBIT loss of SEK 40M (compared to SEK 4M loss in 2024), and operating cash flow turning negative at SEK -73M (from SEK 57M in 2024), while cash reserves declined to SEK 30M.

candidate_sentences.text: Net sales decreased by 16 percent to SEK 295.3 million, down from SEK 352.9 million in 2024.
EBITDA fell significantly to SEK 17.5 million from SEK 46.7 million in 2024.
The operating result after depreciation and impairment was a loss of SEK 40.0 million, compared to a loss of SEK 4.0 million in 2024.

Operating cash flow also deteriorated, moving from a positive SEK 56.8 million in 2024 to a negative SEK 72.6 million in 2025, largely due to the timing of revenue recognition and working capital changes associated with project delays.

verified_key_information_units.information: Business restructuring into two segments (Products & Missions and Data & Services) to enhance operational efficiency, with Data & Services segment growing net sales by approximately 80% to SEK 80M (from SEK 45M in 2024) driven by recurring maritime data revenues from operational Sedna satellites.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Operations section (page 9-11), CEO Review (page 6), Business segments highlights (page 11)

candidate_sentences.text: Despite the lower top line, the Data & Services segment demonstrated strong growth, with net sales increasing by 78 percent to SEK 80.1 million from SEK 44.9 million in the prior year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major contract acquisitions including ESA's INFLECION Phase 1 agreement (part of a SEK 350M co-funded program with 50% UK Space Agency contribution) and SEK 11.8M order for EPS-Sterna weather constellation components, significantly boosting order backlog and providing multi-year revenue visibility.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Significant events during the year (page 32)

candidate_sentences.text: Key business developments during the period included the signing of a Phase 1 contract with the European Space Agency for the INFLECION programme, aimed at developing a satellite constellation for maritime intelligence.
The company also received an order for long-lead components for the EPS-Sterna weather constellation and began assembly of its first VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites.

verified_key_information_units.information: Key operational milestones: Sedna-1 and Sedna-2 satellites became fully operational strengthening maritime AIS network capacity; first CubeCAT laser communication terminals delivered enabling high-speed optical links; assembly commenced on first two VIREON™ Earth Observation satellites for 2026 launch.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: 2025 in brief (page 5), Weather technology praised by ESA section (page 5), Operations structured in two segments (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32)

verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Institutional ownership strengthened section (page 5), Board of Directors' Report (page 32), Top 10 shareholders table (page 18)

details.completeness_justification: All core material information from the fixed criteria is adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 covers financial performance metrics (sales, EBITDA, EBIT, cash flow). K2 covers the business restructuring and Data & Services growth. K3 covers major contract acquisitions (ESA INFLECION and EPS-Sterna). K4 covers operational milestones (Sedna satellites, CubeCAT terminals, VIREON assembly). K5 covers Bonnier Capital investment details. K6 covers market positioning strategy. K7 covers liquidity management and equity ratio. Only K8 (post-reporting-period events) is missing, but this does not change the overall understanding of the main picture as the summary captures all other HIGH-importance material information comprehensively.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. It consistently explains the decline in financial performance through operational delays and shifted revenue timing. All statements about financial metrics (net sales, EBITDA, operating loss, EPS, cash flow) logically follow from the described operational challenges. The growth in the Data & Services segment is presented as a positive counterpoint without contradiction. Business developments (contract signings, satellite operations, share issues) are presented as context for investments and liquidity management, aligning with the reported financial results. There are no self-contradictions, logical gaps, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. The summary forms a clear narrative arc from performance decline to strategic investments and balance sheet strength.
